title: Recycle Rewards container refund scheme (Tasmania)
summary: Tasmania's Recycle Rewards scheme launched on 1 May 2025, paying a 10-cent refund on eligible containers funded by beverage industry contributions.
direction_rationale: Beverage suppliers must register containers and pay per-container scheme costs, a compliance cost that weighs more on small and interstate producers/importers (potential barrier and price effect), while new refund-point and materials-recovery businesses enter.
